lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately 8-10 visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, transitioning from high density near the mid-lateral line to lower density towards the dorsal ridge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the centroid blobs, forming a series of rectangular nodes primarily visible in the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible across the upper flank, displaying a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity values on the superior edge and deep shadow gradients on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of roughly 12-15 high-luminance blobs, primarily clustered toward the lower two-thirds of the fin's macro-mask silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A thin, dark linear artifact resembling a fishing line or leader is embedded in or trailing from the apex of the first dorsal fin; a minor notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the same fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately 11 yellow-and-black striped pilot fish (Naucrates ductor) are visible in the foreground, primarily positioned adjacent to the gill region and pectoral fin.
